findings.message: Gateway "gw1" has 2 outgoing flows but no default flow set.
findings.suggestion: Set a default flow to handle unmatched conditions.
Name start events using "Object + past participle", e.g. "Order Received", "Payment Initiated".
Label split gateways as a yes/no question, e.g. "Invoice valid?", "Order approved?".

findings.message: Sequence flow "f1" from split gateway "gw1" has no condition label.
findings.suggestion: Label each outgoing flow with the condition answer, e.g. "Yes", "No", "Approved", "Rejected".

findings.message: Sequence flow "f2" from split gateway "gw1" has no condition label.
findings.suggestion: Label each outgoing flow with the condition answer, e.g. "Yes", "No", "Approved", "Rejected".
Name end events using "Object + state", e.g. "Order Fulfilled", "Payment Failed", "Request Rejected".
Name end events using "Object + state", e.g. "Order Fulfilled", "Payment Failed", "Request Rejected".

findings.message: Exclusive gateway "gw1" has no default sequence flow.
findings.suggestion: Add a default flow to ensure the process does not get stuck when no condition matches.

findings.message: Start event "s" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.

findings.message: Variable "x" is referenced but never set in this process.
findings.suggestion: "x" is never set on any path through this process.
Set isExecutable="true" — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a non-executable process.

fixes.description: Set default flow to "f2" on gateway "gw1"
fixes.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="proc">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="s">
      <bpmn:outgoing>f0</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw1" default="f2">
      <bpmn:incoming>f0</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>f2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="e">
      <bpmn:incoming>f1</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="e2">
      <bpmn:incoming>f2</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f0" sourceRef="s" targetRef="gw1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="gw1" targetRef="e">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>= x > 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="gw1" targetRef="e2">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>= x <= 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
